business_problem: Allianz UK underwriters had to search through as many as 70 lengthy guidance documents during underwriting, spending significant time finding the right rules and answers, which slowed response times, risked missing critical information, and made it harder for junior staff to get timely guidance.
solution_summary: Allianz UK built BRIAN, an in-house generative AI Underwriter Guidance Tool, to help commercial underwriters retrieve policy and risk guidance from internal documentation. The system ingests uploaded underwriting guides, currently covering all Property and Casualty and Specialty line documents, and digests them into a searchable knowledge base. Underwriters ask natural-language questions in BRIAN’s interface, and the tool returns concise answers generated only from the uploaded source documents. To support traceability and compliance, each response also links directly to the exact section of the original guidance used to generate the answer, including very large documents. Allianz says the tool was developed jointly by business, transformation, technology, and datalab teams, is already in full production, and is being scaled across more users, documents, and business lines.
